name: Will a new toilet save me money on my water bill?

mainEntity.name: Will a new toilet save me money on my water bill?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, upgrading to a new, water-efficient toilet can significantly reduce your water bill, especially if your current toilet is an older, high-gallon-per-flush model. Many modern toilets are WaterSense certified and use 1.28 gallons per flush or less, compared to older models that might use 3.5 to 7 gallons. This practical tradeoff offers ongoing savings, which is particularly beneficial for residents in water-conscious regions like Las Vegas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a new, water-efficient toilet, especially WaterSense certified models, can significantly lower your water bill compared to older, high-gallon-per-flush units.
